title: MACD Divergence with RSI Filter on BTC 1h — Momentum Reversal Strategy
objective: Research whether MACD histogram divergence from price (hidden bullish/bearish divergence) combined with RSI oversold/overbought filter produces profitable entries on BTC 1h candles. Hypothesis: divergence signals trend exhaustion, and RSI filter reduces false signals, producing Sharpe > 1.0 OOS on the 5-year BTC dataset. This is a different signal class from price-based RSI/SMA/Bollinger/BB Width strategies already tested.
hypothesis: MACD histogram divergence identifies trend reversals earlier than price-based indicators. RSI filter (below 40 for longs, above 60 for shorts) confirms momentum exhaustion, producing Sharpe > 1.0 OOS with WFR > 0.5. The combination is additive: divergence identifies the turning point, RSI confirms the pullback is deep enough to be a real reversal.
strategy_rationale: MACD histogram divergence is fundamentally different from all prior strategies: (1) Price-based: RSI, SMA crossover use raw price or smoothed price. (2) Volatility-based: BB Width Squeeze, Volatility Regime use ATR/Bollinger width. (3) Spread-based: cross-asset pairs. (4) Existing MACD in crypto_day_of_week uses MACD histogram as a day-filter, not divergence detection. Hidden divergence is a momentum-reversal signal that has never been tested. It is theoretically grounded: price makes HH/HL while momentum makes LH/LL = exhaustion pattern.

historical_depth_requirement.target: 5 years of hourly BTCUSDT data (~43,000 candles)
historical_depth_requirement.justification: 5 years of hourly data provides ~20+ WFA folds at 3mo train/1mo test/1mo step. This depth enables statistically meaningful WFR computation and captures multiple market regimes (bull, bear, sideways, high-vol events). Prior experiments failed due to only 500-1000 candles producing 2-6 trades per fold.

data_acquisition.reason: binance_btcusdt_1h_deep.csv exists with 43,789 lines covering 2021-03-22 to 2026-03-21. Column format: timestamp,open,high,low,close,volume. This is sufficient for full WFA.

implementation_steps: 1. Create strategy file: walk forward engine/src/strategies/macd_divergence.py implementing MACD histogram divergence detection with RSI filter. Must implement generate_vectorized_signals(self, data, params=None).
2. Create params file: walk forward engine/config/strategy_macd_divergence.json with parameter ranges for Optuna.
3. Create WFA config: walk forward engine/strategies/macd_divergence/wfa_config.yaml pointing to binance_btcusdt_1h_deep.csv, 3mo train/1mo test/1mo step, 100 trials.
4. Human runs WFA locally: cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/macd_divergence/wfa_config.yaml

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA must complete at least 10 out-of-sample windows with minimum 20 total trades across all windows. Blocked if data or strategy code fails to load.

fallback_if_blocked: If Optuna takes > 30 min, reduce to 50 trials
If strategy produces < 20 trades across all folds, fall back to shorter parameter ranges (fewer divergence lookbacks)
If WFA engine fails on deep data, fall back to binance_btcusdt_1h_full.csv (6481 candles) with same strategy
notes: Strategy MUST implement generate_vectorized_signals() for WFA compatibility
Divergence detection: compare N-bar price swings vs N-bar MACD histogram swings. Price makes lower low + MACD makes higher low = bullish divergence.
RSI filter: long entries only when RSI < rsi_oversold, short entries only when RSI > rsi_overbought
Human runs the WFA engine locally — agent writes strategy + config only
5-year history via binance_btcusdt_1h_deep.csv is already present — no download needed
